title: Graduation
subtitle: 本課限定語境：graduation = the completion of a course of study and/or the formal ceremony marking
description: 本課限定語境：graduation = the completion of a course of study and/or the formal ceremony marking that completion · 「畢業；畢業典禮」

words.note: 表示完成某個課程、學位或學習階段。
words.example: She moved abroad after the completion of her studies.
words.exampleZh: 她完成學業後移居海外。

exercises.original: She plans to travel after graduation from university.
exercises.zh: 她計劃大學畢業後去旅行。
exercises.upgrade: She plans to travel after the completion of her studies.

options.explanation: 只指畢業典禮，不一定等同完成學業的時間點。
最直接表示她完成大學學業。
更常見於離校，不夠正式表達大學畢業。

exercises.original: Graduation marked the end of four years of study.
exercises.zh: 畢業標誌著四年學習的結束。
exercises.upgrade: The completion of studies marked the end of four years of study.

options.explanation: 重點就是四年學業完成。
通常不能直接替代此抽象名詞片語。

exercises.original: Many students start full-time work soon after graduation.
exercises.zh: 很多學生完成學業後不久便開始全職工作。
exercises.upgrade: Many students start full-time work soon after the completion of their studies.

options.explanation: 這裡重點是完成教育階段後進入工作。
工作開始不一定以典禮日期為界。

words.note: 在上下文已清楚是課程／學位時，可表示學業完成。
words.example: Students receive a certificate on successful completion of the course.
words.exampleZh: 學生成功完成課程後會獲頒證書。

exercises.original: Graduation from the training program requires all assessments to be passed.
exercises.zh: 完成培訓課程需要通過所有評核。
exercises.upgrade: Completion of the training program requires all assessments to be passed.

options.explanation: 不適合一般培訓課程完成。
最中性地表示完成課程。

exercises.original: Students receive a certificate upon graduation from the course.
exercises.zh: 學生完成課程後會獲得證書。
exercises.upgrade: Students receive a certificate upon completion of the course.

options.explanation: upon completion of the course 是標準搭配。
指典禮，不適合所有課程。
部分地區可指典禮，但不是課程完成本身。
結構應是 upon completing，不是直接替換名詞。

exercises.original: Graduation from the online course can take as little as six months.
exercises.zh: 完成這個網上課程最快可只需六個月。
exercises.upgrade: Completion of the online course can take as little as six months.

options.explanation: 課程結業時間最自然用 completion。
典禮本身不會「花六個月完成」。

words.note: 表示學生結束在某所學校的就讀階段並離校。
words.example: The school held a special event for school-leaving students.
words.exampleZh: 學校為即將離校的學生舉行特別活動。

exercises.original: The school organized a celebration for students approaching graduation.
exercises.zh: 學校為即將離校的學生舉行慶祝活動。
exercises.upgrade: The school organized a school-leaving celebration.

options.explanation: 強調即將結束在該校的學生階段。
北美可指畢業典禮，但題句更泛指離校慶祝。

exercises.original: Students receive guidance about work and college before graduation from school.
exercises.zh: 學生離校前會獲得有關工作和升學的指導。
exercises.upgrade: Students receive guidance about work and college before school-leaving.

options.explanation: 重點是結束學校階段、準備下一步。
是典禮，不等於整個離校階段。

exercises.original: The survey asked young people about their plans after graduation from secondary school.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問年輕人中學離校後的計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The survey asked young people about their plans after school-leaving.

options.explanation: 中學後升學／就業規劃語境自然。

words.note: 直接指正式慶祝完成學業的典禮。
words.example: Her parents attended the graduation ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 她的父母出席了畢業典禮。

exercises.original: Her parents travelled to attend her graduation.
exercises.zh: 她的父母專程前來出席她的畢業典禮。
exercises.upgrade: Her parents travelled to attend her graduation ceremony.

options.explanation: attend 明確表示一個正式活動。
可以有活動，但不是最直接。

exercises.original: The graduation will take place in the school hall.
exercises.zh: 畢業典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。
exercises.upgrade: The graduation ceremony will take place in the school hall.

options.explanation: 不是在某禮堂「舉行」的活動。
地點＋take place 明確是典禮。
如果是大學學位正式授予可接近，但題句只是一般 school graduation。

exercises.original: Students must collect their gowns before graduation.
exercises.zh: 學生必須在畢業典禮前領取畢業袍。
exercises.upgrade: Students must collect their gowns before the graduation ceremony.

options.explanation: gowns 是典禮的明確線索。
學業完成本身不需要畢業袍。

words.note: 在美國及部分北美高等教育語境中，commencement 常指畢業典禮。
words.example: The university's commencement will be held in June.
words.exampleZh: 大學畢業典禮將於六月舉行。

exercises.original: The university's graduation ceremony will be held outdoors.
exercises.zh: 大學畢業典禮將在戶外舉行。
exercises.upgrade: The university's commencement will be held outdoors.

options.explanation: 北美大學語境中是 graduation ceremony 的標準用詞之一。
不自然形容大學正式典禮。

exercises.original: Thousands of families attended the graduation at the university stadium.
exercises.zh: 數千個家庭在大學體育場出席畢業典禮。
exercises.upgrade: Thousands of families attended the commencement at the university stadium.

options.explanation: 大型大學畢業活動、家屬出席，特別符合北美用法。

exercises.original: The president gave a speech at graduation.
exercises.zh: 校長在畢業典禮上致辭。
exercises.upgrade: The president gave a speech at commencement.

options.explanation: speech at commencement 是北美常見搭配。
可能是典禮其中一部分，但不是整場活動。

words.meaning: 學位頒授典禮；畢業典禮
words.note: 表示大學正式頒授學位的儀式。
words.example: Graduates must register in advance for the degree ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 畢業生必須預先登記參加學位頒授典禮。

exercises.original: She invited her family to her university graduation.
exercises.zh: 她邀請家人出席大學學位頒授典禮。
exercises.upgrade: She invited her family to her degree ceremony.

options.explanation: 大學＋正式頒授學位，是最精確。
不夠正式，也不聚焦學位。

exercises.original: Graduates must register online for the graduation ceremony where degrees are formally awarded.
exercises.zh: 畢業生必須網上登記參加正式頒授學位的典禮。
exercises.upgrade: Graduates must register online for the degree ceremony.

options.explanation: 北美可用，但題句明確強調正式授予 degree，degree ceremony 更精確。
通常用單數名詞作定語：degree ceremony。

exercises.original: Academic dress is required at graduation.
exercises.zh: 學位頒授典禮要求穿著學術禮服。
exercises.upgrade: Academic dress is required at the degree ceremony.

options.explanation: academic dress 是大學學位典禮典型搭配。

words.meaning: 取得資格；達到資格要求
words.note: 表示完成要求後取得某項正式資格。
words.example: After qualifying, she began work as a pharmacist.
words.exampleZh: 取得資格後，她開始擔任藥劑師。

exercises.original: After graduation from professional training, she began work as a pharmacist.
exercises.zh: 取得專業資格後，她開始擔任藥劑師。
exercises.upgrade: After qualifying, she began work as a pharmacist.

options.explanation: 專業培訓後取得可執業資格，最合適。
不一定等於取得專業執業資格。

exercises.original: Graduation allowed him to register as a fully licensed professional.
exercises.zh: 取得資格後，他可以登記成為正式持牌專業人士。
exercises.upgrade: Qualifying allowed him to register as a fully licensed professional.

options.explanation: licensed professional 是專業資格語境。
只表示完成訓練，未必已達正式資格標準。

exercises.original: She started applying for specialist roles immediately after graduation from the certification program.
exercises.zh: 她完成並取得認證資格後立即申請專業職位。
exercises.upgrade: She started applying for specialist roles immediately after qualifying.

options.explanation: 重點是達到 specialist role 所需資格。

words.meaning: 學位授予；正式頒授學位
words.note: 非常正式，表示學位被官方授予。
words.example: The conferral of the degree takes place at the ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 學位正式授予會在典禮上進行。

exercises.original: Graduation formally gives the student the university degree.
exercises.zh: 畢業過程中，學位會正式授予學生。
exercises.upgrade: The conferral of a degree formally gives the student the university degree.

options.explanation: 完成學業與正式法律／行政授予學位不是完全同一件事。
精確表示官方正式授予學位。

exercises.original: The university records the student's graduation once the degree is formally awarded.
exercises.zh: 學位正式授予後，大學會記錄該學生的畢業。
exercises.upgrade: The university records the conferral of the degree once it is formally awarded.

options.explanation: 是活動，不等於正式授權行為本身。

exercises.original: The official graduation process includes verification, approval, and formal award of the degree.
exercises.zh: 正式畢業程序包括核實、批准以及正式授予學位。
exercises.upgrade: The official process includes the conferral of a degree.

options.explanation: 是典禮，不是正式行政授予本身。
verification + approval + formal award 完全符合。
需要完整語法結構，如 to confer a degree。

words.note: 可理解為正式頒授資格的典禮。
words.example: The training provider held a qualification ceremony for successful candidates.
words.exampleZh: 培訓機構為合資格學員舉行資格頒授典禮。

exercises.original: The training provider held a graduation event for candidates who had completed the professional certificate.
exercises.zh: 培訓機構為完成專業證書的學員舉行資格頒授典禮。
exercises.upgrade: The training provider held a qualification ceremony for successful candidates.

options.explanation: 在專業證書／培訓提供者語境中可理解且合適。
主要是北美學校／大學畢業典禮。
如果不是 degree，範圍不對。

exercises.original: Successful trainees attended a graduation ceremony where their certificates were formally presented.
exercises.zh: 成功完成培訓的學員出席正式頒發證書的資格典禮。
exercises.upgrade: Successful trainees attended a qualification ceremony.

options.explanation: certificate qualification + formal presentation，語義可成立。
如果證書不是學位就不精確。

exercises.original: The college used the phrase “qualification ceremony” for its graduation event.
exercises.zh: 學院以「qualification ceremony」稱呼其畢業活動。
exercises.upgrade: The college used the phrase qualification ceremony for its graduation event.

options.explanation: 可以理解，但不是所有英語地區最常見的標準說法。

falseSynonyms.zh: 完成 ≠ 必然畢業 可以完成一個短課程，但未必屬正式 graduation。
離校 ≠ 必然畢業 有人可以離校但未完成畢業要求。
畢業典禮 ≠ 所有 graduation 義項 它主要指典禮，而不是「完成學業」本身。
學位 ≠ 畢業 degree 是獲得的資格，不是 graduation 這個事件／過程。
畢業文憑 ≠ 畢業本身 diploma 是文件或資格證明。
正式集會 ≠ 在所有地區都等於畢業典禮 某些大學把 graduation ceremony 稱為 convocation，但各地用法不同。
詞形陷阱 - graduate = 畢業生；畢業 - graduation = 畢業／畢業典禮 - graduating = 即將畢業的
詞形不同 - qualify = 取得資格 - qualification = 資格 - qualified = 合資格的
